g.text: UNVALIDATED ZERO REFERENCE: E_re is the unshifted absolute RHF total energy, including nuclear repulsion.
No physical zero threshold is established. Passing E_total < 0 is an algebraic result,
not a determination that a physical vibrational level is bound.
Equilibrium = 0.955463 Å; highest n passing <0 among n=0,1: 1; reference shift = 0 Ha
n=0 turning coordinates: [0.866740, 1.044185] Å | n=1 turning coordinates: [0.801791, 1.109134] Å

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4b5969

g.text: Both panels use the same unshifted absolute reference. The left panel magnifies the harmonic energy spacing; the right includes literal zero.
